data.name: Fries Drive
data.detailed_description:
🚐 Fries Drive - Drive. Cook. Conquer.

Run your own food truck across vibrant locations in this charming cooking simulation. Switch between top-down isometric driving and immersive first-person cooking as you build your street food empire - one perfectly crispy batch at a time.

Whether you're cruising between sunny beaches and bustling concert grounds, or hustling inside your kitchen to nail the perfect order, Fries Drive delivers a satisfying blend of cozy atmosphere and time-management depth.

🌍 Five Unique Locations

Each spot has its own vibe, customer flow, and pricing and you'll need to earn your way to the next:

  • 🏕️ Camping - Where every fries legend begins. Quiet, forgiving, perfect for learning the ropes.

  • 🎤 Concert - Hungry crowds, fast orders, no time to breathe.

  • 🏛️ Old Town - Cozy streets and loyal regulars who appreciate a well-seasoned fry.

  • 🏖️ Beach - Sunny days, premium prices, and customers ready to splurge.

  • 🌆 City - The big leagues. The hardest crowd. The biggest paydays.

🍳 First-Person Cooking That Feels Great

Park your truck and step into the kitchen. Slice raw potatoes, drop them in the fryer, shake on the right seasoning, add the perfect sauce, then box it all up — every step is hands-on and satisfying. Master [b]12 unique fry recipes[/b], from classic salted fries to spicy paprika-ketchup deluxe.

🌶️ The Secret Is in the Seasoning

Salt, chili, paprika, ketchup, mayo — every topping you add boosts the price of an order. The customer ordered plain fries? Sure. But add a sprinkle of paprika and a drizzle of mayo, and watch your earnings jump. Experiment, find your formula, and turn ordinary orders into premium ones.

⚡ Upgrade Every Corner of Your Kitchen

Pour your earnings into faster fryers, sharper knives, expanded sauce stations, and more. Each upgrade speeds up your workflow and opens the door to bigger orders, busier locations, and richer customers.

📈 Popularity = Power

Serve fast, serve friendly, and watch your reputation grow. Climb the popularity ladder to unlock new market items, premium upgrades, and entry to the most lucrative spots in town. Mess up too many orders and you'll feel it — every customer counts.

🤖 Automate Your Empire

Reach the late game and unlock automation for every kitchen station — slicer, fryer, seasoner, saucer, packager. Watch your truck practically run itself as you shift from line cook to fries tycoon.

✨ Cozy Vibes, Just Enough Heat

Bright low-poly visuals. Soft ambient soundscapes. A satisfying loop that's easy to learn but hard to put down. Perfect for fans of [b]cooking simulators, food truck games, and cozy management experiences[/b].

🎮 Key Features

  • ✅ Hybrid gameplay — isometric driving meets first-person cooking

  • ✅ unique locations with progressive difficulty and pricing

  • ✅ fry recipes built from spice and sauce combinations

  • ✅ Deep upgrade tree, plus late-game automation for every station

  • ✅ Popularity-based progression that rewards quality service

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8300H or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB) or equivalent
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB)
